facts.statement: Dahalokely was an extinct carnivorous abelisauroid theropod dinosaur that lived in Madagascar during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Dahalokely is an extinct genus of carnivorous abelisauroid theropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous (Turonian) of Madagascar.

facts.statement: The species Dahalokely tokana was named by Farke and Sertich in 2013.
facts.quote: The type species, Dahalokely tokana, was named by Farke and Sertich in 2013.

facts.statement: The genus name Dahalokely means "small thief" in Malagasy, referencing its estimated length of 3.5 meters, which is smaller than other known abelisaurids.
facts.quote: The generic name, Dahalokely, means "small thief" in Malagasy, deriving from its estimated length of 3.5 m, smaller than those of known abelisaurids.

facts.statement: The specific name tokana means "lonely" in Malagasy, referring to the isolation of the Madagascan subcontinent.
facts.quote: The specific name, tokana, means "lonely" in the same language in reference to the isolation of the Madagascan subcontinent.

facts.statement: The genus has the Life Science Identifier 8147803A-D4BE-4BA9-9701-D853E 37DE411 and the species has the LSID AFAE32BB-123A-45D4-B931-4FF2A ABAF41C.
facts.quote: In the ZooBank, the genus has the Life Science Identifier 8147803A-D4BE-4BA9-9701-D853E 37DE411 and the species the LSID AFAE32BB-123A-45D4-B931-4FF2A ABAF41C.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen UA 9855 was found in the Ambolafotsy Formation in northern Madagascar, dating to about 93 million years ago.
facts.quote: The holotype, UA 9855, was uncovered in what is informally named the Ambolafotsy Formation, a Turonian-age deposit of the Diego Basin in northern Madagascar, about 93 million years old.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a partial skeleton of a subadult individual that lacks a skull but preserves vertebrae and ribs.
facts.quote: It consists of a partial skeleton lacking the skull of a subadult individual, preserving vertebrae and ribs.

facts.statement: Initial size estimates placed Dahalokely at 3.5 meters long, based on the assumption that it was built like an abelisaurid.
facts.quote: Initial size estimates of Dahalokely, at 3.5 m, were based on the assumption it was built like an abelisaurid.

facts.statement: If Dahalokely had the elongated build of noasaurids, it would have been between 4.2 and 5.6 meters long.
facts.quote: Should it have had the more elongated build of the noasaurids, it would have been 4.2 - 5.6 m long.

facts.statement: A 2016 estimate placed the length of Dahalokely at 3.8 meters.
facts.quote: It was estimated as being 3.8 m in length in 2016.

facts.statement: The cervical vertebra features a markedly convex lamina between the prezygapophysis and epipophysis, which is longer than the vertebral body and separated by notches.
facts.quote: The cervical vertebra has a lamina, bone sheet, between the front joint process, the prezygapophysis, and a rear process, the epipophysis, the edge of which lamina is markedly convex, the convex part being longer than the vertebral body and separated from both the prezygapophysis and the epipophysis by conspicuous notches.

facts.statement: The second dorsal vertebra has strongly concave joint facets on its rear processes.
facts.quote: With the second dorsal vertebra, the joint facets of the rear joint processes, the postzygapophyses, are strongly concave.

facts.statement: Dahalokely was assigned to the superfamily Abelisauroidea in 2013.
facts.quote: In 2013, Dahalokely was assigned to the Abelisauroidea.

facts.statement: In 2014, Dahalokely was classified as a basal noasaurid.
facts.quote: In 2014, Dahalokely was placed as a basal noasaurid.

facts.statement: A 2018 study recovered Dahalokely as part of a clade with the Indian abelisaurid Rahiolisaurus within the subfamily Majungasaurinae.
facts.quote: A phylogeny from 2018 recovered Dahalokely as forming a clade with the Indian abelisaurid Rahiolisaurus within majungasaurinae.

facts.statement: A 2021 study recovered both Rahiolisaurus and Dahalokely as basal brachyrostran carnotaurines.
facts.quote: In the 2021 description of Llukalkan, both Rahiolisaurus and Dahalokely were recovered as basal brachyrostran carnotaurines.

facts.statement: Separate studies from 2018 and 2022 recovered Dahalokely as a noasaurid based on phylogenetic analyses.
facts.quote: However, two separate studies from 2018 and 2022 instead recovered Dahalokely as a noasaurid based on their phylogenetic analyses.

facts.statement: Dahalokely tokana lived in the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 93 to 89 million years ago, during the Turonian stage in what is now Madagascar.
facts.quote: Dahalokely tokana ("pequeño ladrón solitario") es la única especie del género extinto Dahalokely de dinosaurio terópodo abelisauroide que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico hace aproximadamente 93 a 89 millones d años durante el Turoniense de lo que es hoy Madagascar.

facts.statement: In 2007, Joseph Sertich discovered the remains of a new theropod near Antsiranana, northern Madagascar, during an expedition led by Andrew Farke.
facts.quote: En 2007, durante una expedición de Andrew Farke al norte de Madagascar, Joseph Sertich descubrió cerca de Antsiranana los restos de un terópodo nuevo para la ciencia.

facts.statement: The fossils were fully excavated in 2010 by Sertich and Liva Ratsimbaholison.
facts.quote: En 2010, estos fueron completamente excavados por Sertich y Liva Ratsimbaholison.

facts.statement: The name Dahalokely means "small thief" in Malagasy because it is estimated to have been about 3.5 meters long, which is smaller than many other abelisauroids.
facts.quote: Dahalokely significa "pequeño ladrón" en idioma malgache debido a que se estima que medía unos 3.5 metros de largo, menor que muchos otros abelisauroides.

facts.statement: The species name tokana means "solitary," referring to the isolation of the Malagasy subcontinent.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie tokana significa "solitario" en referencia al aislamiento del subcontinente malgache.

facts.statement: The holotype was found in the informal Ambolafotsy Formation, part of the Diego Basin in northern Madagascar, dating to approximately 93 million years ago.
facts.quote: El holotipo, UA 9855, fue descubierto en lo que se denomina informalmente la formación Ambolafotsy que es parte de la cuenca Diego al norte de la isla con cerca de 93 millones de años de antigüedad.

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a partial skeleton lacking a skull, representing a subadult individual that preserves vertebrae and ribs.
facts.quote: Consiste en un esqueleto parcial que carece del cráneo, es un individuo subadulto, conservando vértebras y costillas.

facts.statement: During the Turonian, Madagascar and India were part of the same landmass that had separated from the rest of Gondwana.
facts.quote: Durante el Turoniano, Madagascar y la India eran parte de la misma masa terrestre que se habían separado del resto de Gondwana.

facts.statement: Dahalokely is the only known dinosaur from Madagascar from the time the island was separated from Gondwana but still connected to India, forming Indo-Madagascar.
facts.quote: Dahalokely es el único dinosaurio conocido de Madagascar de la época en que la isla estaba separada de Gondwana pero aún conectada con la India, formando Indo-Madagascar.

facts.statement: The phylogenetic position of Dahalokely among abelisauroids is uncertain.
facts.quote: La posición filogenética de Dahalokely entre los abelisauroides es incierta.

facts.statement: Its vertebrae and ribs possess characteristics of both abelisauroid groups, the Noasauridae and Abelisauridae.
facts.quote: Sus vértebras y costillas tienen características de los dos grupos de abelisauroides, los noasáuridos y los abelisáuridos.

facts.statement: An initial phylogenetic analysis found Dahalokely to be a basal Noasaurid, but this result has weak support.
facts.quote: Un análisis filogenético publicado junto con su descripcicón científica inicial encontró que Dahalokely es un noasáurido basal, pero este resultado tiene un débil soporte.

facts.statement: The incompleteness of the remains and lack of comparable material make it difficult to determine Dahalokely's precise relationships with other abelisauroid members.
facts.quote: Lo incompleto de los restos y la carencia de material que pueda compararse con el de otras especies de abelisauroides significan que díficilmente se puedan determinar las relaciones precisas de Dahalokely con los demás miembros de su grupo.

facts.statement: Dahalokely is classified within the family Abelisauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Abelisauridae

facts.statement: Dahalokely lived during the Turonian stage, between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Turonian (93.9 to 89.8 million years ago)
